location_exception_reason: FRP modular toilets are mass-manufactured, nationally distributed commodities. Location of manufacture or seller does not alter the product's functional attributes (material, capacity, waste system, dimensions). Buyer decision is driven by specifications and price, not origin geography.
biz_exception_reason: Business-type words (Manufacturer, Supplier, Dealer, Distributor) in titles are redundant — IndiaMART's seller-type filter already exposes this independently. Removing 'Manufacturer' from 'FRP Toilet Manufacturer' leaves a complete, accurate product title; the business relationship is not part of what is being sold.
